title: The Christ of God to Sorrowing Hearts
description: The Christ of God to Sorrowing Hearts in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the Greek Office Books (Paisley, 1904).
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Common Metre (8.6.8.6), and this page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: The Christ of God to sor-rowing hearts A gra-cious pro-mise made, To send to them when He de-parts The Ho-ly Spi-rit's aid.

lines: The Christ of God to sorrowing hearts
To send to them when He departs
And when the time appointed came,
The house was filled with tongues of flame,
And souls received new power from God,
And hearts with zeal were fired,
When once the word of truth abroad
Now, as of old, come down,
And with the power of Pentecost

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the Greek Office Books (1904)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the Greek Office Books; set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
